WITH balances AS ( SELECT r.due_date, GREATEST(r.amount - COALESCE(red.amount, 0) - COALESCE(wo.amount, 0), 0) AS open_amount FROM xsy_finance_receivable r LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT SUM(amount) amount FROM xsy_finance_receivable x WHERE x.original_receivable_id=r.id AND x.entry_type='RED' AND x.deleted=FALSE) red ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN entry_type='NORMAL' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) amount FROM xsy_finance_write_off x WHERE x.target_type='RECEIVABLE' AND x.target_id=r.id AND x.deleted=FALSE) wo ON TRUE WHERE r.settlement_customer_id=#{settlementCustomerId} AND r.entry_type='NORMAL' AND r.deleted=FALSE ) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(open_amount),0) AS open_receivable_amount, MIN(due_date) FILTER (WHERE open_amount > 0 AND due_date < (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date) AS earliest_overdue_date, NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xsy_sales_order o WHERE o.settlement_customer_id=#{settlementCustomerId} AND o.deleted=FALSE
AND FALSE AND (o.seller_id IS NULL OR o.seller_id NOT IN #{id}) AND TRUE ) AS exposure_visible FROM balances

SELECT o.id FROM xsy_sales_order o WHERE o.settlement_customer_id=#{settlementCustomerId} AND o.status='CONFIRMED' AND o.deleted=FALSE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xsy_finance_receivable r WHERE r.source_type='SALES_ORDER' AND r.source_id=o.id AND r.deleted=FALSE) ORDER BY o.id
